hits.title: The Power of Migration on Identical Machines is Two
hits.abstract_snippet: We study the power of migration in preemptive scheduling on identical parallel machines with time windows. If an instance admits a migratory schedule on $m$ machines, how many machines are needed to schedule it without migration? hits.title: Spectral conditions for the existence of $\{K_2,\{C_k\}\}$-factor in $t$-tough graphs
hits.abstract_snippet: For $t>0$, a graph $G$ is called $t$-tough if $|S|\geq t\,c(G-S)$ for every $S\subseteq V(G)$ with $c(G-S)\geq2$, where $c(G-S)$ denotes the number of components of $G-S$.
